name: Rey Vasquez
action: grabs a mug, wipes the kitchen table
thought: I can’t let Nia have the last word

speech.text: You still think you can take my side, Nia?

name: Dot Feeney
action: flips a page in her hidden ledger
thought: Everyone owes me, but none will admit it

name: Wes Doyle
action: stares at the post, taps his pen
thought: Gus will bite if I push too hard

speech.text: Your move, Petrakis, before I lose patience

name: Hector Delgado
action: scribbles a note on the post, avoids eye contact
thought: Yusuf still thinks he can cheat me

speech.text: Don’t forget who signed off on that shipment

name: Clemmie Bello
action: passes the radio to Tee, smiling
thought: Maybe this song will keep the tension low

name: Otis Bello
action: holds the radio steady, watches the street
thought: If I speak up, they’ll think I’m grown‑up

name: Rufus Adeyemi
action: scrubs the sink, humming a quiet tune
thought: Cleaning feels like fixing the mess inside

text: Cassius Reyes takes a side in something that was not their argument.
action: Cassius Reyes takes a side in something that was not their argument.

event: The Harbor Bar is full and loud and for a few hours nothing is wrong.

name: Tiny Reyes
action: sits up against the headboard, rubbing her eyes
thought: Something scraped the stairs outside, or it was just the radiator pipe again.

speech.text: Go back to sleep, little bit. Nobody's creeping out there.

name: Sgt. Hal Brennan
action: rolls onto his side, snoring into the flat pillow
thought: Sixty-seven weeks until the paperwork clears, if the city doesn't fold first.

name: Dev Nakamura
action: turns over heavily, pulling the quilt to his chin
thought: Cannery horn blows at six sharp regardless of who got sleep.

name: Etta Adeyemi
action: pulls the thin blanket higher over her brother
thought: Milo tosses every time a car takes the curb too fast.

speech.text: Keep still, Milo. Morning comes fast enough.

name: Etta Bello
action: pulls her knees to her chest under the blanket
thought: Grown-ups think when your eyes close the ears turn off too.

speech.text: I heard the gate latch drop twice, Tiny. Honest.

name: Milo Adeyemi
action: stares up at the water stain on the ceiling
thought: The streetlamp makes the crack in the plaster look like a dog.

speech.text: Is that the patrol car coming back to the corner, Etta?

name: Milo Adeyemi
action: counts breaths softly into the collar of his shirt
thought: Four counts in, four counts out, until the room settles down.

speech.text: Hush up, you're going to get Ruiz waking up.

text: Day 848: the city took $1,832 and spent $810. Treasury $346,517.

headline: Nothing Goes Wrong At Harbor Bar

event: Malik Reyes finds the count is short again. Not by much. Enough.

name: Booker Lyle
action: Sets a tarnished brass clock on the shelf.
thought: Wes stays too close to the till when my back turns.

speech.text: Step back two paces, Wes. You crowd the aisle.

name: Odette Ferreira
action: Straightens a carton of split cabbage heads by the entrance.
thought: Dot thinks paying a fine makes her clean. It does not.

speech.text: Watch who comes through that latch, Cal. Wind rattles it.

name: Nia Nakamura
action: Wipes grease off the belt feeder with an oily rag.
thought: Hector runs this line on prayers and loose bolts.

speech.text: Rattling's louder near the hopper, Hector. Gear teeth are slipping.

name: Cassius Bello
action: Chews on a plastic cup while staring at the screen.
thought: Loud voices on the box, but the rug feels soft.

name: Isaac Adeyemi
action: Crawls under the side table, peering along baseboards.
thought: Shiny ring with keys went somewhere behind the radiator.

speech.text: Not under here, Ma. Just dust bunnies.

name: Jonah Bello
action: Turns the television volume down one notch.
thought: Too many cousins yelling over the weather report again.

speech.text: Sit down before you trip on Cassius, little man.

name: Jonah Bello
action: Clambers onto the couch arm, watching the screen flicker.
thought: Jonah told me to sit, but the couch is crowded.

event: Ms. Priya Raman does Booker Lyle a favour that costs them something real.

name: Ms. Priya Raman
action: closes the transcript file with a heavy thumb
thought: The paperwork has to look clean enough the state never looks twice.

speech.text: Sign the bottom line, Nadia. Don't read into the phrasing.

name: Rufus Bello
action: tips plastic cup onto a pothos leaf
thought: The leaves drink it up fast.

speech.text: Look, Theo, it drank the whole cup.

name: Theo Bello
action: stares at the flicker of daytime television
thought: They treat me like I don't see what's happening outside.

speech.text: Don't drown it, Rufus, or Jonah's gonna yell.

name: Errol Lindqvist
action: straightens a crooked row of cigarette packs
thought: Too many drivers sitting in one corner makes the register look poor.

speech.text: How's the tape looking on today's run, Farrah?

name: Farrah Mbeki
action: aligns paper receipts on the metal spindle
thought: Figures don't lie, but the men reading them sure try to.

speech.text: Ten dollars short on the four o'clock shift, like usual.

name: Cal Serrano
action: leans his shoulder against the glass doorframe
thought: Four cars idling on the street and none of them ours.

speech.text: Town car circled the block twice. You recognize the plates?

name: Errol Brannon
action: wipes dust off the counter laminate
thought: Cal jumps every time a sedan slows down near the curb.

speech.text: Just livery from downtown, Cal. Stop staring at the glass.
